about: AP Calculus AB concept dependency map (docs/apcalc-spec.md, docs/apcalc-phase0.md): the 81 AB topics in CED order (BC-only numbers skipped), the "Math you need" skills with the topic each comes before, and every concept with the topic that teaches it, the concepts it depends on and, for math notation, the TeX patterns that use it. Our own words; no CED text. Checked by scripts/check-apcalc-map.mjs.

everydayWords.about: Common words a student already roughly knows. They may be used in their everyday sense before the topic that teaches them; the technical terms of the same concept stay strict ("instantaneous velocity", "absolute maximum", "definite integral").

circularDependencies.problem: Local linearity (4.6) asks whether a tangent line estimate is an over- or underestimate, which follows from the sign of the second derivative, before 5.6 teaches concavity.
circularDependencies.detail: A short version: where f'' > 0 the graph bends up (concave up) and lies above its tangent lines, so a tangent line estimate is an underestimate; where f'' < 0 it bends down and the estimate is an overestimate. 5.6 owns concavity on intervals and points of inflection.
